items.title: Sanity-check out-of-graph scene_location authored by LLM
items.body:
M4 smoke-run finding (2026-07-21).

Twice in one run the model named a location outside the geography graph ("The Vale", then "Town Square - The Vale") with no relocate mutation; the travel-gate + graph validator correctly no-op'd both (no player-visible corruption).

The `place - region` format matches the display convention (`src/discord/map-render.ts:117`, `src/llm/prompt-builder.ts:243`) - the model is likely echoing a compound display string back into the raw `scene_location` field.

**Acceptance:** determine whether prompt/context renders location as `place - region` somewhere the model could mistake it for the field value; fix or document.

items.title: Surface bail-refund grace to the player (first step-back today is free)
items.body:
M4 smoke-run finding.

The once-per-day free step-back (`last_bail_refund_day`, `src/engine/WorldEngineImpl.ts`) reads as inconsistent: first bail refunds a roll, second same-day does not, with nothing explaining it. Add a small UI note. Not a bug.

items.title: Promote engine anomaly logs to transcript findings in agent harness
items.body:
M4 enhancement.

Engine-emitted anomaly recoveries (`category-telemetry`, `travel-gate` injections/drops) print to stderr but the agent-player harness does not capture them as findings, so they are invisible in the run scoreboard. Hook these engine emissions into transcript warnings.

items.title: C6 symptom-A: combat-intended actions mis-classified as skill/rest
items.body:
0.3.2 residual, deferred. Route via the `prompt-versioning` skill; a published prompt set is copied, never edited in place. See [[prompt-v13-roadmap]].

Actions the player intends as combat are sometimes classified as `skill`/`rest`, routing to the wrong spine. The auto-resolve guard (C6) prevents a combat-classified action resolving without a fight, but the upstream classify decision is a prompt-template concern.

items.title: Add kind/slot/consumable column to ItemData
items.body:
RA-1 Stage 1 follow-up.

The engine cannot distinguish a consumable from a weapon and cannot hold consumables to +1, so the v13 "consumable reads +1" guidance is prompt-only and unenforced until such a column exists.

items.title: C4 follow-up: abandoned mid-round combat shows no opening frame on resume
items.body:
A genuinely unfinished multi-round fight leaves `last_action_state` set; `/action` then hits the resume branch (`action.ts:162`), which calls `buildDecisionMessage` without `actionType`, so no opening frame renders (and `decisionIdx > 0` would gate it out anyway). Latent, not the reported symptom.

Needs `resumeAction`/`ActionResumeResult` to carry actionType + remembered foe and the render gate to allow a combat opener on resume.

items.title: C4 follow-up: in_combat edge duplication on anchor change
items.body: `set_relation`'s UNIQUE key includes the anchor (`to_type,to_ref`), so a re-engage that resolves to a *different* anchor than the bailed edge creates a second `in_combat` edge; `readCombatState` then picks whichever the DB returns first. Harmless for same-anchor re-engage (the common path). Needs an edge-lifecycle sweep, not part of the C4 symptom fix.

items.title: Make NPC minting a hard guarantee for combat/social actions
items.body: Originally [/] - largely addressed: RA-3 mints a surviving named foe, and v13's `add_npc` tells the model to mint a narrated newcomer on first sight. What is left is making it a hard guarantee (engine-enforced) rather than prompt guidance.

items.title: Investigate removing the classify-stage critic (latency)
items.body: Latency seems high; mine prod for investigation. Note: RA-4 already gated the narrate critic (`CRITIC_GATE_MODE`, default `narrate-gated`); this item is the classify stage specifically. Conditionally remove.

items.title: Refactor frame left padding from two spaces to one
items.body: Many frames have two spaces of left padding; refactor to one.

items.title: Rework map render: show unexplored adjacent edges greyed out in the main tree
items.body:
Current behaviour: an unexplored path (e.g. The Stag's Den off The Forest Edge) renders only in the bottom "Unexplored paths" block, not in the main tree. A player looks at "you are here" first, then around them; the Forest Edge not showing its onward edge there is bad UX.

Desired: render unexplored adjacent edges in the top tree, greyed out / marked unexplored, instead of only in a detached bottom list.

Original map dump preserved in TODO.md history.

items.body: Small UX win from the POC polish list.

items.title: Travel prompt should inject current location, edge, destination state and routes
items.body: The travel prompt should inject the current location, the edge being traversed, the final location state, and the routes to get there.

items.title: Deterministic movement on low-difficulty terrain (effort budget)
items.body:
Movement on low-difficulty terrain can be deterministic up to a total of 3 effort (3x difficulty-1 edges, or a 1+2). Traversing a >=3 difficulty edge in one action must trigger the travel prompt.

Actions that involve movement indirectly (e.g. "search the library" from the Warden's Oak) should first evaluate the travel beat (auto-travel, or demand travel as a separate action).
